title: A report opened from a tile shows its Date filter panel once, with no jump
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as {User-A} (for example Admin ShopView), whose role has the Reports permission, at location {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919).
  • Your browser window is at least 1024 pixels wide at 100% zoom (a maximised laptop or desktop window).
custom_steps:
1. Click Dashboard in the top bar.
  2. Click the report icon beside Revenue and watch the Date filter panel while the Sales report opens.
  3. Click Reports in the top bar, click Sales in the left menu, and watch the Date filter panel while it opens.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 2: The Date filter panel appears once, already in its final place. It does not appear somewhere else first and then jump.
  • Step 3: It appears the same way as in step 2.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-490; story SV-9584 (Story 12, Visual Conformance); Dashboard v1 PRD, Confluence 788430850, version 48 (14 Oct 2026, 17:09 UTC, Chris Ward), S12-R6 (added in version 45 on 14 Oct 2026 (15:06 UTC) by Chris Ward, from Chris Ward's answer 13 of 14 Oct 2026 to our question sheet, one rule per defect ticket SV-10891; the spec's change log (version 46) lists it under 2026-10-14); read 14 Oct 2026. Source-verified 14 October 2026. Not yet checked against a build.
